Lets a Ducter task use this phone\'s apps, only while you lend it one

When a task asks to use this phone and you say yes, Ducter reads the screen of the app in front and taps, swipes and types for it. A pill at the top shows it\'s happening, with Stop. Anything that sends, pays or deletes waits for your Go; banking, wallet, password and authenticator apps stay out of reach, and password fields are never read or typed. Off between tasks: it reads nothing until you lend it the phone.
When you\'re done, tap Done on the card
